name: Active Directory Attack
description: Multi-vector Active Directory penetration testing with advanced exploitation techniques

parameters.name: attack_type
parameters.description: Choose the Active Directory attack technique to execute

parameters.name: domain_controller
parameters.description: Target domain controller address (IP or hostname)

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Valid domain credentials - leave blank for unauthenticated attacks

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Domain user password or NTLM hash

parameters.name: stealth_mode
parameters.description: Slower scans with reduced detection risk

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Maximum time for operation before abort

examples.desc: DCSync attack to extract all domain password hashes
BloodHound enumeration for privilege escalation paths
AS-REP roasting to find accounts without pre-authentication
